subject: Add reply schema for LATENCY-LATESTS new fields (#1678)
reason: The diff only edits the reply_schema metadata in src/commands/latency-latest.json to document the sum and count fields LATENCY LATEST already returns; the reply-producing code in src/latency.c is unchanged and already emits six elements on both the parent and the change. Reply schemas are not compiled into a regular server build, so there is no observable behavior difference between the two builds for any command sequence, fault, or tool run to detect.
